name: customer-support
description: A short support history with a plan change, a move and a contradiction, to exercise extraction, deduplication and invalidation.

episodes.name: msg-1
episodes.content: Alice Chen: Hi, I'm on the Pro plan and I work at Acme Robotics in Berlin. Can you help me add a teammate?

episodes.name: msg-2
episodes.content: Support (Ravi): Sure Alice. I've added Bob Martinez to your Acme Robotics workspace.

episodes.name: msg-3
episodes.content: Alice Chen: We just upgraded to the Enterprise plan today because the team grew to 40 people.

episodes.name: doc-1
episodes.content: Alice Chen moved from Berlin to Lisbon in April 2026 and now leads the robotics platform team at Acme Robotics. Bob Martinez reports to her.

episodes.name: msg-4
episodes.content: Bob Martinez: Hi, Alice left Acme Robotics last week, so I'm the new billing contact for our account.

queries: What plan is Acme Robotics on?
Who is the billing contact for Acme Robotics?
Who does Bob Martinez report to?
